scenes.picture: On a dark hilltop, an old stone fort shaped like a star, and a silly queen marching up and down its yard holding a glass jar with a glowing page inside.

sentences.text: The sky is dark.
Vex is marching in the yard.
The spell is in a jar.
Vex has the jar!

scenes.picture: At the gate of a star-shaped fort, a bouncy boy holds up a curly brass horn and a cheerful boy holds a torch, as storm clouds roll in from the north.

sentences.text: Chip got a horn at the fort.
Bix has a torch.
A storm is in the north.
Vex ran to the porch.

scenes.picture: Inside a dark stone fort during a thunderstorm, a clever girl and a baby find a ladder in a corner, a spider hangs from a thread, and a silly queen climbs up out of sight.

sentences.text: Thunder is not a monster.
Nell is under the ladder.
A spider is in the corner.
Vex hid the paper up the ladder.

scenes.picture: At the top of a fort tower, a little purple bird chirps from its nest, a goofy crow flaps, and a silly queen reaches into the nest for a glowing page.

sentences.text: A purple bird is in the nest.
The bird can chirp and chirp.
The bird and Gus chirp at Vex.

scenes.picture: In the yard of a star fort, a slow old turtle carries a glowing page on its shell, and two boys kneel down to talk to it kindly.

sentences.text: A turtle has the spell.
It is hard work to catch it.
Chip has a kind word.
The turtle will stop for Chip.

scenes.picture: Over a star-shaped fort, the night sky fills with stars, a child holds up a glowing page, and a silly queen slips over in the dark.

sentences.text: You got the spell!
A star is in the sky.
Vex fell in the dark.
The best fort in the world!

side.picture: At the bottom of a hill, a small dog barks happily at a red barn, and a small stuffed elephant is wrapped up in balls of yarn like a present.

sentences.text: Dash is barking at the barn.
Phil is in the barn.
Phil has a lot of yarn.

side.picture: At a dinner table in a stone fort, a very big sleepy cat eats bread and butter, then dozes off right on the table while a bouncy boy laughs.

sentences.text: Thud had a big dinner.
Thud has a lot of butter.
Thud is better after dinner.
